name: Nagakute (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nagakute city emblem in green: a stylised device of a loop and crossed strokes, like the character 長.
history: Municipal flag of Nagakute, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1971.

features.role: Nagakute city emblem — a stylised device of a loop and crossed strokes, like the character 長
